data.name: Fauqaan
data.gender_notes: Fauqaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘fauq’ meaning ‘above’ and ‘‘aan’ meaning ‘to support’, Fauqaan refers to someone who raises or supports others. In Islamic history, Fauqaan refers to an individual who stands up for the truth and supports righteous causes. The name Fauqaan carries the meaning “Raiser, Supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fauqaan usually hope their child will grow to embody raiser, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes support, strength, and resilience in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Fauqaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Raiser, Supporter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fauqaan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
